dataset.name: MNIST (LeCun et al.)
dataset.adaptation: 28x28 uint8 -> [0,1] -> bilinear downscale to 16x16 -> flattened 256-dim input

splits.validation_carve: stratified 500/class (5000 total) carved from the 60000 training images, seed 777; used ONLY for Phase B config selection
splits.test_note: full 10000-image MNIST test set, identical for every configuration

model.name: MLP 256->64->64->10, dropout 0.3 (project's shared MLP with input_dim=256)

protocol_changes_vs_synthetic_run: Training pool is 55,000 not 60,000: 5,000 training images are held out as the Phase B validation split. Test set unchanged (full 10,000).
Centralised epochs 80 -> 30 (baseline): MNIST-16 validation curve plateaus far earlier than the synthetic problem; CPU is shared. A 60-epoch run is screened in Phase B.
DP rows use the non-IID (Dirichlet alpha=0.5) partition as specified for this real run; the synthetic run's DP rows used IID, so synthetic-vs-real DP rows are not partition-matched.

DP lot size 32 -> 256 and DP lr 0.15 -> 0.4: measured torch.func per-sample step cost ~195 ms at lot 32 (~110 min per sigma at original scale) vs ~34 ms at lot 256 (~2.5 min per sigma); lot>=256 is also the recommended DP regime in the improvement brief. Epsilon estimates recomputed for the actual sigma/q/steps.
Input dimension 20 -> 256 (16x16 MNIST), model params 6,154 -> 21,258. All other methods (FedAvg aggregation, FedProx mu, per-sample DP clipping, epsilon estimation) are the project's own, unchanged.
epsilon_caveat: All epsilon values are the project's simplified RDP ESTIMATE (federated.estimate_epsilon), for comparing noise levels inside this project only. They are NOT a formal/certified (epsilon, delta) privacy guarantee; production accounting requires Opacus / TF-Privacy's exact RDP accountant.

phaseb_scope_notes: Phase B candidates DROPPED for CPU budget (shared 1.5-CPU cell with 4 other parallel project agents; centralised baseline alone took 811 s): pb_fedprox_noniid_long (FedProx 40 rounds), pb_fedavg_iid_long (FedAvg IID 40 rounds), pb_central_long (centralised 60 epochs). Not run; no numbers are claimed for them.

The rounds lever is still screened where it matters most (FedAvg non-IID, 40 rounds x 2 local epochs vs baseline 15 x 3) and server momentum/FedAdam are screened at 30 rounds; the FedProx family is screened over the mu sweep at baseline rounds; the centralised baseline's stored per-epoch validation curve shows its plateau (val 0.9634 @ epoch 10 -> 0.9710 @ epochs 29-30).
extension_note: Extension round after the first finalize: the DP lr trend on validation (0.4 -> 1.0 gave +5.7 pts at sigma=0.7) had not plateaued, so lr=2.0 was screened on validation at both sigmas (20 rounds, same epsilon-estimate levels) plus a 40-round lr=2.0 run at sigma=0.7 as a higher-epsilon frontier level (epsilon estimate 15.31). Both lr=2.0 configs won their families on validation and were evaluated on test once; superseded winners' log decisions were updated. No other family's final entry changed.
runtime_note: Sum of per-configuration wall-clock runtimes recorded on the shared 1.5-CPU cell (torch threads=4, OMP_WAIT_POLICY=PASSIVE); contention from parallel jobs makes individual runtimes variable - treat as order-of-magnitude.
